verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, and such a service could plausibly offer agent-scoped API credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers incorporation, EIN and 83(b) filings, banking and perks, and never mentions API keys, restricted or scoped credentials, or agent access. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
